issues.detail: The skill assumes a TypeScript environment, limiting cross-platform applicability.

scenarios.name: validate-env-with-coercion
scenarios.rationale: Response B meets almost all rubric items, while Response A lacks zod usage and prettified error handling.

scenarios.name: discriminated-union-request-validation
scenarios.rationale: Response A better meets the rubric by using a discriminated union and flattenError, while Response B uses a plain union; both miss the required refine, strictObject, and role key.

scenarios.name: recursive-category-schema-with-json-schema
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers most rubric items (recursive schema with getter, JSON schema generation, codec) but omits type inference; Response B fails to use a getter, z.codec, and z.infer, making it less compliant.
